name: Sota Metal Fabrication LLC
old_description: It all started back in 2004 . . . Steve was working for Air Pro, LLC under the mentorship of industry leader Michael McFarland. After Michael’s tragic death in 2010, Steve purchased the company. Under a new name, Chimney Doctors, Steve continued providing the high-quality service and repair that Air Pro had been known for. His vision is to provide quality, transparent service, up to date educational resources, and peace of mind to homeowners, contractors, and the real estate industry.
about:
Sota Metal Fabrication LLC operates from Burnsville, Minnesota. The business traces its roots to 2010, when Steve acquired Air Pro, LLC after the death of its founder Michael McFarland and relaunched it as Chimney Doctors. The company later adopted the Sota Metal Fabrication name while continuing to serve the chimney and fireplace market under the ChimGuard product line.

The company manufactures a full range of custom chimney components including full-coverage caps, shrouds, pots, shoulder guards, gable and barrel roof caps, chase covers, and crickets. All products are fabricated to custom measurements in the company's local facility using a no-weld construction method on caps. The shop also provides design and engineering support for unique chimney challenges.

Primary customers are chimney sweeps, hearth contractors, roofing professionals, and real-estate inspectors across the residential construction and chimney-service sectors. The firm also sells directly to homeowners seeking code-compliant protection for masonry and factory-built chimneys.

Steve's original vision was to bring transparency and education to chimney service. That mission carries into the product line: every ChimGuard item carries a lifetime replacement warranty, and the full-coverage cap design is intended to eliminate return trips by fitting correctly the first time.
